text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At that day's meeting,
I decided to make a certain proposal to Hishi Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Look for reference videos on my own... is that what you mean?
choice_data_list: Right, while thinking about what you're lacking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In coaching Hishi Miracle, right now I'm the one
instructing her on form corrections tailored to her running,
as well as strength training exercises.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, becoming used to simply being taught everything by us
isn't good either. She must also cultivate the ability
to think through her own flaws.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, alright.
I'll give it a try~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And so, after setting aside some time to have her look up the video—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~, looks so tasty~...
Subscribing to this UmaTuber for sure.
choice_data_list: ...What video are you watching?
...What video are you watching?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!?
Ah, um. No!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That was just a coincidence! It was just a brief pause to catch my breath,
and I just happened to look at the fluffy, soft omurice, or something.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Seriously, until five minutes ago I was watching proper videos!
Like 'Muscle Strength Needed for Acceleration' uploaded by famous trainers~!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I'm telling the truth~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And thirty minutes later.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hmm... hm, hm...♪
choice_data_list: (I hear another totally unrelated video playing...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On top of that, Hishi Miracle is starting to lie down on the sofa. Should I call this off? The thought crossed my mind—
choice_data_list: (No, let's bet on her and hope for a miracle!)
(...Let's give up on that and switch to classroom study.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe there's still a chance for a comeback even from here.
Believing that, I decided to watch over her, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Mmh... Zzz... Munya...
choice_data_list: (She's finally asleep...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the next moment, the smartphone slipped vigorously
from Hishi Miracle's hands—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Oof?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
M-My nose... owie~!
Ugh~... my phone...
choice_data_list: That's what you get for dozing off.
That's what you get for dozing off, huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah...
choice_data_list: You've had your rest, so let's make up for it with training, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: A-Ahaha... Um.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Okaaay...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we cut the plans short
and decided to just do regular training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe there's still a chance for a comeback even from here.
Believing that, I decided to watch over her, and—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: The next recommended video is... hmm?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
about this video...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The video Hishi Miracle found was about an
elementary schooler learning about the "Late-Charge"
style from an active, top-tier Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I kinda just 'felt' like my running style was naturally 'Late Surger' (Sashi).

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still, this video's goal is to turn that "vague sense"
into a "solid" understanding.
Plus, it's made for little kids, so it's super easy to follow.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I did a little bit of self-reflection.
Realizing I only had a vague understanding of it.
choice_data_list: …! You found a great video!
…! You found a great video, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: No, no, it's more like... watching the video made me realize just how hopeless I am.
choice_data_list: That's what counts! I knew you could do it!
That's what counts! I knew you could do it if you tried!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh? Too much praise isn't good, you know?
It'll go straight to my head.
choice_data_list: Go ahead and get carried away—you're growing, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Geez, Trainer-san, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, perhaps we grew just as much
as we reflected on our mistakes?
choice_data_list: That's why you want to grow even more, right?
That's why you want to grow even more, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that's true.
Hehehe.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's get right to training!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Geez, Trainer, you meany~!
Can't we just do the real thing tomorrow instead~?!"
choice_data_list: I want to see the fruits of your hard work today.
I want to see the fruits of all your hard work today.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*. Even if the results only show a little bit,
please go easy on me, okay~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe there's still a chance for a comeback even from here.
Believing that, I decided to watch over her, and—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hehe... ah. —Hm?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Trainer.
In short, a collaboration! A collab!
choice_data_list: A collab?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It hit me while watching a collab video by some UmaTubers.
Taking in other people's perspectives and ideas is really important!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: So for me, that would mean...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe participating in a mock race, or something?
choice_data_list: (I-it's just normal training...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, the core concept isn't bad.
To make them think even more and turn this into
a more effective training exercise—
choice_data_list: Who do you think I should collab with, for example?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how about... inviting girls who are
in a similar situation as me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm counting on you today!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Umm~, Trainer-san?
There are only girls here who
look nothing like me though~?
choice_data_list: Just like you, she's great at late surges.
Just like you, she excels at late-charging.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Nah, no way!
There's a way bigger difference than that.
Star quality, star quality!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Besides, I probably won't win, you know?
Not unless a miracle or something happens."
choice_data_list: You can make a miracle happen!
You can make miracles happen.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Trainer, you always say stuff like that with such dead seriousness.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: What will we do if even I become overconfident?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That day's mock race ended with a result that was just a little bit, a tiny bit...
of a miracle for Hishi Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as I approached Hishi Miracle,
who was lounging on the sofaâ

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... *inhale*... *exhale*...♪
*inhale*...
choice_data_list: (She's humming in her sleep!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And she's doing it while skillfully gripping her smartphone with both hands.
Her forehead, usually hidden by her bangs, is shining brightly too.
choice_data_list: Good grief...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...!
Oh, a blanket...?
choice_data_list: You're awake? Then let's study
You're awake? Then let's study

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me~.
Um, uh, well—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you
for putting a blanket over me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I decided to hold a special, longer-than-usual
classroom session for Hishi Miracle.
